notice: Cells are the report's own words. The report is AI-written; it names a source for each row, which VetBuddy has not opened. Leads to check, never benefit records.
generic_agr_phrases: (?i)drill(/| ?, ?)AGR( & retired pay)?|AD/AGR|NG/Res/AGR(/Tech)?|\(drill, AGR & retired pay untaxed\)

relations.program_in_vault: a vault record in this jurisdiction names the program the report names
relations.vault_has_guard_education_record: the vault has a Guard education record here; whether it is the same program is not confirmed
relations.not_in_vault: the report names a Guard education program and the vault has none here: research target
relations.report_lists_none: the report says there is no territorial Guard tuition program, and the vault has none
relations.report_lists_none_vault_has_record: the report says there is none, but the vault has a record: a conflict to review
